scope: Historical website observations and independently exercised main-checkout PL/EN correction. Each record names its own verification scope; these counts are not benchmark scores or a live uptime dashboard.

provenance_boundaries.public_sources: Source references point to curated public summaries, not raw private receipts. Historical snapshot counts were supplied in the redesign brief; they are attributed records, not independently rerun measurements of the redesigned site.
provenance_boundaries.acceptance: All five declared cut verifiers, including assembly, passed under the supervisor. The operator independently exercised the assembled local HTTP and browser surfaces. Owner approval and deployment of this redesign remain separate.
